info.title: caltodo API
info.description: Tasks that live as Google Calendar events. Every failure answers RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`. A request that is not GET must send the CSRF token of `GET /api/auth/user` as the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

delete.summary:
Deletes the stored data of the user and signs out. The calendar events
stay in Google Calendar.

403.description: Problem `csrf_rejected`: the CSRF token is missing or wrong.

429.description: Problem `rate_limited`: too many requests from this client.

post.summary:
Completes or reschedules the task of an action link, then writes a new
link into the event and uses up this one.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The raw action token of the link.

requestBody.description: The action. The HTML form of the action page sends the same fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and gets an HTML page back.

413.description: Problem `payload_too_large`: more than 100 KiB of JSON or 50 KiB of form data.

429.description: Problem `rate_limited`: too many requests from this client.

ActionName.description: The action of an action link.

csrfToken.description: The CSRF token, for a form post without the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

The CSRF token of the session. Send it as `X-CSRF-Token` on every
request that is not GET, HEAD, or OPTIONS.

CalendarListItem.description: One calendar of the user's Google calendar list.

CalendarTask.description:
A task (`CalendarTask`). Instants are UTC with milliseconds, like
`2026-03-02T15:00:00.000Z`.

duration.description:
The duration in whole minutes; `null` when the event ends at or before
its start.

priority.description: The position among the incomplete tasks; 0 for a completed task.

details.description: At most 5000 UTF-16 code units. Omit it rather than send `null`.

urgent.description: Move the task to the front of the schedule. The default is `false`.

duration.description: Whole minutes, 15 to 480. The default is the settings duration.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details body with the application `code` extension.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response.

detail.description: A fixed explanation. It contains no request data.

ProblemCode.description: The stable application code of a public failure.

calendarId.description: Omit to keep the current calendar.
The Google Calendar id for the tasks; `null` until the user selects one.

workEndHour.description: The hour by which tasks end, 0 to 23.

defaultDuration.description: The default task duration in minutes.

eventColor.description: The Google Calendar color id of new events.

sessionCookie.name: caltodo.sid
sessionCookie.description: The HttpOnly session cookie of the Google sign-in. The browser sends it; script never reads it.
